Trayage 1.1.1

Help shape what comes next with optional usage analytics.

  • A one-time invitation lets you choose whether to share basic app usage with TelemetryDeck.
  • Analytics stays off unless you turn it on. File names and contents are never included.
  • Change your choice anytime in Settings → General → Privacy.

The seven-day trial, one-time unlock, and free file review remain available. This direct-download edition supports macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

Trayage 1.1 (9)

Trayage now costs US$9.99 once. The seven-day trial and free file review remain available.

  • The direct Buy action opens the updated $9.99 Stripe checkout.
  • Existing direct licenses and local settings continue to work.
  • Trayage 1.1 adds a redesigned overview, Glance and Quick review menu choices, smart filters, and local duplicate checks.

This direct-download edition supports macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Apple purchases remain separate from direct licenses. Trayage only moves files to Trash after you select and confirm them; it never empties Trash.

Trayage 1.1 (7)

A new look shaped by your feedback, with more ways to give Downloads a second look.

  • A new tray icon, violet colors, and a redesigned overview in light and dark modes.
  • Choose Glance or Quick review for your menu bar.
  • Start with 14 smart-filter presets or save your own All/Any rules. Preview matches and pin favorites.
  • Hide suggestions while keeping their files, and restore hidden suggestions in Settings.
  • Compare likely duplicate downloads locally and set optional folder-size reminders.
  • Clearer Settings and Billing, text sizes up to 200%, and visible refresh feedback.
  • A personal thank-you from Kyle, available again in About.

File review stays on your Mac. Nothing is selected or removed automatically: you choose files and confirm before they move to Trash. Trayage never empties Trash.

This is the direct-download edition for macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Your existing settings and direct license stay with your installation. Stripe checkout and Keylight licenses remain unchanged; Apple purchases are separate.
